result.summary: Fixed Redmine #44623. Headings that come from a macro's output no longer get "Edit this section" links and no longer count as sections of the page. The exception is a macro defined with the new `:sections => true` option. Only `collapse` uses it, so headings written inside a collapse block keep their links. How it works: when a macro without `:sections` returns headings, `inject_macros` wraps its output in HTML comment markers. `parse_sections` keeps a nesting depth from these markers and skips headings inside them. A `@macro_depth` counter keeps the markers in place during nested `textilizable` calls, so an include inside a collapse is still detected. The markers are removed at the end of the outermost `textilizable` call. Included headings are still rendered normally: they keep their anchors and still appear in the TOC. Tests: the full suite passes (6066 runs, 0 failures, 0 errors, 64 skips; the skips are for SCM repositories, LDAP and ImageMagick, which are not set up here). I could not run the new tests against the code without the fix: my command to revert the fix temporarily was denied. So I did not see them fail on the old code.

changes.summary: New marker constants and SECTION_HEADING_RE. parse_sections skips headings between markers. inject_macros wraps the output of non-:sections macros that contain headings, and tracks @macro_depth. textilizable removes the markers at the top level (new remove_macro_section_markers method).
New :sections macro option (accepted by assert_valid_keys and documented), new macro_sections? helper, and collapse is now declared with :sections => true.

3 new tests: include macro between local headings (edit links, section numbers checked against formatter.get_section, included headings still have anchors, no marker left in the output), include inside collapse, and custom macros with and without :sections.
New test for registering a macro with the :sections option and for macro_sections? (collapse, include, unknown macro).

acceptance.criterion: On a page with local headings and an included page, only the local headings get edit links, and their section numbers match the numbers used when editing the page
acceptance.evidence: test_section_edit_links_with_include_macro passes: exactly 2 section divs (section-2 for Section A, section-3 for Section B), the included headings have no edit links but still have anchors, and Redmine::WikiFormatting.formatter#get_section(2) and get_section(3) return Section A and Section B.

acceptance.criterion: The change is covered by tests
acceptance.evidence: 4 new tests (3 in application_helper_test.rb, 1 in macros_test.rb); both files pass: 194 runs, 0 failures. Not checked: that the new tests fail without the fix, because the temporary revert command was denied.

acceptance.criterion: The existing test suite still passes
acceptance.evidence: bin/rails test: 6066 runs, 31675 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 64 skips (SCM repositories, LDAP and ImageMagick are not set up).
